title: Tome of Binding
description: Tome of Binding allows you to teleport to players and view information about them, such as their coordinates and dimensions.
body:
[Github](https://github.com/qvokee/Tome-of-Binding) [Curseforge](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tome-of-binding)
# ABOUT
A Minecraft mod that adds two magical artifacts:
Tome of Binding — a magical book that allows you to teleport to other players and view information about them, including their coordinates and the dimension they are in.
Scroll of Vision — a magical scroll with the same functionality as the Tome of Binding. It is used in the crafting of the Tome of Binding.
